en: A vintage illustration of a young female angel with large white wings, wearing a flowing white robe accented with gold dots. She stands in front of a stylized Gothic-style window or arch with blue sky panels and green grass visible through the openings. The angel holds the hem of her robe in one hand, with a small bouquet of colorful flowers resting in the fold. The card has a decorative, religious, and somewhat Art Nouveau look, with gold embellishments around the borders.
